title: Everyone "Knows" Eve Caused the Fall. The Quran Never Even Names Her.
excerpt: The assumption that Eve is to blame for the first sin is one of the most settled in the religious imagination — yet the Quran's account of the fall never names the woman at all. The eating is told in the dual (both, together), the one clause of disobedience names Adam (20:121), and the repentance is a shared 'we have wronged ourselves' (7:23). A corpus-grounded reading set beside the more famous telling.
seo_title: Does the Quran Blame Eve for the Fall? She Is Never Even Named
seo_description: The Quran's account of the fall never names Eve: the eating is dual (20:121), the one disobedience-clause names Adam, and the couple repents jointly (7:23). A corpus-verified reading of how the Quran refuses to gender the first sin — with an honest comparison to Genesis.
